title: SREV-070 handle close handler lifetime contract

param_output.description: Optional pParams output slot in Handle_UnRegisterHandler

node_lifetime.description: List removal and Dll_Free ownership release

contracts: Handle_RegisterHandler may initialize and insert a HANDLE_HANDLER node only after Dll_Alloc returns non-null
Handle_UnRegisterHandler pParams is an optional caller-owned output slot
When pParams is non-null, unregister must write the stored Param through *pParams
A handler node removed by Handle_UnRegisterHandler must be released with Dll_Free
A handler node executed by Handle_ExecuteCloseHandler must be released with Dll_Free
The handle module owns HANDLE_HANDLER node lifetime until unregister or close execution
